title: BLACKPINK 2026 World Tour: What to Expect at Seoul Concerts
description: BLACKPINK announces their massive 2026 world tour with Seoul dates at Jamsil Olympic Stadium. Everything fans need to know.
content:
BLACKPINK has officially confirmed their 2026 world tour, and Seoul fans have reason to celebrate: the group will perform four nights at Jamsil Olympic Stadium in September 2026. Here's everything you need to know.

Seoul Concert Dates

  • September 12-13, 2026 — Jamsil Olympic Stadium
  • September 19-20, 2026 — Jamsil Olympic Stadium

Tickets go on sale through Interpark and Melon Ticket. International fans can use Interpark's English-language portal.

Getting to Jamsil Olympic Stadium

The stadium is directly accessible via Seoul Metro Line 2 (Jamsil Station, Exit 6) or Line 8 (Mongchontoseong Station). Expect extreme crowds on concert days — arrive at least 2 hours early.

💡 Pro Tip: The area around the stadium fills up with unofficial merchandise vendors starting 4-5 hours before showtime. Official merch lines form inside 3 hours before gates open.

What to Expect from the Show

Based on their Born Pink and previous world tours, expect:

  • 90-minute main set + 20-minute encore
  • Full solo sections for each member
  • Elaborate costume changes (typically 6-8 outfits)
  • Pyrotechnics and custom LED stage setup
  • Special Seoul-only unit stages
🏨

Stay Near Jamsil for Concert Week

Hotels near Lotte World and Jamsil fill up fast during major concerts. Book early on Agoda.

Find Hotels Near Jamsil →

Fan Zone Activities

YG typically sets up a massive fan zone around the stadium perimeter. In 2024, this included photo booths, merchandise popups, and fan art galleries. The 2026 tour is expected to be even larger.
